idea-plugin.name: LatherIt
idea-plugin.description:
LatherIt is a fast, modern client for SOAP and REST services - an alternative to SoapUI, right inside your IDE. Open a *.latherit.yaml project file and it shows up as a LatherIt editor.

Preview: the LatherIt user interface is currently available in German only.

Features

  • Import WSDLs, generate sample requests, send them and inspect the response.
  • REST requests with query, path, matrix and header parameters.
  • Test suites with assertions, property transfers and scripts (JavaScript).
  • Mock services for SOAP and REST, running inside the IDE while the editor tab is open.
  • Authentication: Basic, Bearer, Digest and NTLM.
  • Property expansion like SoapUI (${#Project#name}, ${#Env#NAME}, inline scripts).
  • Import SoapUI projects.
  • Project files are plain YAML, made for version control, and saved automatically like any other file in the IDE.
  • HTTPS trusts the certificates of your operating system, like your browser does.

Usage

  • File | New | LatherIt Project creates a project file, File | New | LatherIt Project from SoapUI… imports a SoapUI project (*-soapui-project.xml).
  • Open any *.latherit.yaml file: the LatherIt tab shows the client, the Text tab the YAML.
